## function for exporting tables

```{r}

export_df_to_latex <- function(df, file_path, caption = NULL) {
  
  #-----------------------------
  # Helper: escape LaTeX specials
  #-----------------------------
  escape_latex <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
    x <- gsub("([%&_#\\$])", "\\\\\\1", x)
    x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Convert to character
  df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
  
  # Escape LaTeX characters
  df[] <- lapply(df, escape_latex)
  colnames(df) <- escape_latex(colnames(df))
  
  # Alignment: first left, rest right
  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  align_string <- paste0("l", paste(rep("r", n_cols - 1), collapse = ""))
  
  # Build body rows
  body_rows <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    paste(row, collapse = " & ")
  })
  
  body_rows <- paste0(body_rows, " \\\\")
  body_text <- paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n")
  
  # Header row
  header <- paste(colnames(df), collapse = " & ")
  header <- paste0(header, " \\\\")
  
  # Caption + label handling
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  
  if (is.null(caption)) {
    caption_text <- gsub("_", " ", file_name)
  } else {
    caption_text <- caption
  }
  
  label <- paste0("tab:", file_name)
  
  # Build LaTeX table
  latex_table <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[t]
\\centering
\\fontsize{12pt}{14pt}\\selectfont
\\begin{tabular}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", align_string, "}
\\toprule
", header, "
\\midrule\\addlinespace[2.5pt]
", body_text, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_text, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}"
  )
  
  # Write file
  writeLines(latex_table, file_path)
  
  message("LaTeX table exported to: ", file_path)
}



```


```{r}

build_latex_single_row <- function(dm_row, ri_row, file_path, caption = NULL) {

  dm_header  <- paste(c("", names(dm_row)), collapse = " & ")
  dm_datarow <- paste(c("\\% of grid-intervals", dm_row), collapse = " & ")

  ri_header  <- paste(c("", names(ri_row)), collapse = " & ")
  ri_datarow <- paste(c("\\% of grid-intervals", ri_row), collapse = " & ")

  file_name   <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  caption_txt <- if (is.null(caption)) gsub("_", " ", file_name) else caption
  label       <- paste0("tab:", file_name)

  body <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[t]
\\centering
\\fontsize{11pt}{13pt}\\selectfont
\\begin{tabular}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}lrrrrr}
\\toprule
\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\textit{Panel A: USDM Drought Classification (\\% of grid-intervals $\\geq$ threshold)}} \\\\
\\midrule
", dm_header, " \\\\
\\addlinespace[2pt]
", dm_datarow, " \\\\
\\midrule
\\addlinespace[4pt]
\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\textit{Panel B: PRF Rainfall Index Payout Frequency (\\% of grid-intervals $\\leq$ threshold)}} \\\\
\\midrule
", ri_header, " \\\\
\\addlinespace[2pt]
", ri_datarow, " \\\\
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_txt, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}"
  )

  # Escape all bare % signs (that aren't already escaped)
  body <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", body, perl = TRUE)

  writeLines(body, file_path)
  message("Exported: ", file_path)
}

# ── Compute single-row percentages ────────────────────────────────────────────
years     <- start_year:end_year
intervals <- 625:635

dm_thresholds <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
ri_thresholds <- c(0.90, 0.85, 0.80, 0.75, 0.70)

DM_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
  apply(1, \(x) paste0("DM_median_", x[1], "_", x[2]))

RI_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
  apply(1, \(x) paste0("cpc_index_", x[1], "_", x[2]))

dm_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(STATE, any_of(DM_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-STATE, names_to = "col", values_to = "DM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(DM))

ri_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(STATE, any_of(RI_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-STATE, names_to = "col", values_to = "RI") %>%
  filter(!is.na(RI))

dm_row <- sapply(dm_thresholds, function(thr) {
  paste0(round(mean(dm_long$DM >= thr, na.rm = TRUE) * 100), "\\%")
})
names(dm_row) <- paste0("DM$\\geq$", dm_thresholds)

ri_row <- sapply(ri_thresholds, function(thr) {
  paste0(round(mean(ri_long$RI <= thr, na.rm = TRUE) * 100), "\\%")
})
names(ri_row) <- paste0("RI$\\leq$", sprintf("%.2f", ri_thresholds))

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_latex_single_row(
  dm_row    = dm_row,
  ri_row    = ri_row,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/summary_dm_ri_thresholds.tex"),
  caption   = "USDM and PRF payout frequencies across all grid-intervals, 2010--2025"
)

```

```{r}


build_latex_two_column <- function(dm_row, ri_row, file_path, caption = NULL) {

  # Add spaces around >= and <= in threshold names
  fix_spacing <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\$\\\\geq\\$", "$\\\\geq$\\\\,", x)
    x <- gsub("\\$\\\\leq\\$", "$\\\\leq$\\\\,", x)
    x
  }

  dm_names_fixed <- fix_spacing(names(dm_row))
  ri_names_fixed <- fix_spacing(names(ri_row))

  # Build DM rows
  dm_body <- paste(
    mapply(function(nm, val) paste0(nm, " & ", val, " \\\\"),
           dm_names_fixed, unname(dm_row)),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  # Build RI rows
  ri_body <- paste(
    mapply(function(nm, val) paste0(nm, " & ", val, " \\\\"),
           ri_names_fixed, unname(ri_row)),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  file_name   <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  caption_txt <- if (is.null(caption)) gsub("_", " ", file_name) else caption
  label       <- paste0("tab:", file_name)

  # Note: use ACTUAL % in the R string here — the gsub at the end will escape them
  body <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[H]
\\small
\\begin{minipage}{0.48\\linewidth}
\\centering
\\textbf{USDM Classification}\\\\[4pt]
\\begin{tabular}{lr}
\\toprule
Threshold & \\% grid-intervals \\\\
\\midrule
", dm_body, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\end{minipage}
\\hfill
\\begin{minipage}{0.48\\linewidth}
\\centering
\\textbf{PRF-RI Payouts}\\\\[4pt]
\\begin{tabular}{lr}
\\toprule
Threshold & \\% grid-intervals \\\\
\\midrule
", ri_body, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\end{minipage}
\\vspace{4pt}
\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}
\\caption{", caption_txt, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{minipage}
\\end{table}"
  )

  # Escape bare % signs (not already preceded by \)
  body <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", body, perl = TRUE)

  writeLines(body, file_path)
  message("Exported: ", file_path)
}

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_latex_two_column(
  dm_row    = dm_row,
  ri_row    = ri_row,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/summary_dm_ri_thresholds.tex"),
  caption   = "USDM and PRF payout frequencies across all grid-intervals, 2010--2025"
)

```
